description: Train a simple neural network to predict which TMs are likely to be high-scoring based on their transition table features, then use predictions to guide enumeration.
mathematical_formalization: f_theta: R^(n*k*3) -> R predicting log(sigma(M)); train on simulation data
implementation_hypothesis: Encode transition table as feature vector; train on 100K simulated machines; use to rank candidates in TNF enumeration
experiment_seed: Generate training data from 100K 4-state and 5-state TMs; test prediction quality on held-out set
